title: Docker Daemon Connection Failure
problem_summary: Docker commands fail to execute because the client cannot establish a connection to the Docker daemon.
symptoms: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon
preconditions: Docker is installed on the host system
The user has rights to invoke docker commands

steps.instruction: Check whether the Docker daemon service is running.
steps.expected_result: The Docker daemon service is active.
steps.failure_action: Start the Docker service only after confirming it is stopped.

steps.expected_result: Docker socket permissions allow user access.
steps.failure_action: Verify user group memberships for Docker.

verification_checks.description: Verify Docker CLI successfully connects to the daemon.
verification_checks.success_condition: Docker commands execute without daemon connection errors.

docker_connection_uncertain.meaning: Evidence does not yet isolate a specific Docker connection cause

docker_service_running.meaning: Docker daemon service is reported running

docker_service_stopped.meaning: Docker daemon service is reported stopped or not running

docker_socket_permission_issue.meaning: Docker socket permissions prevent client access

check_docker_service_status.meaning: Check whether the Docker daemon service is active

confirm_docker_daemon_running.meaning: Confirm Docker daemon is running and responding

inspect_docker_error.meaning: Inspect the exact reported Docker error message

request_docker_environment_details.meaning: Request relevant system and service status details

verify_docker_socket.meaning: Verify Docker socket file permissions and existence

observation_rules.description: The report states that the Docker service is not running.
The report states that Docker daemon is running.
The report mentions permission denied on the Docker socket.

clarification_rules.question: Is the Docker service currently active, or does it fail to start when invoked?
